title: PZ machine: Flip (laptop)
description: Every harness run of the flip imported by harness/grafana/ingest.py, stock vs optimized there, its hardware

list.name: mode
list.label: mode
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(mode, '') FROM runs WHERE machine = 'flip' ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(mode, '') FROM runs WHERE machine = 'flip' ORDER BY 1

options.content:
## Flip (laptop)
AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 (Zen 5 + Zen 5c cores) · Radeon 890M integrated GPU, Mesa OpenGL · 1920×1080 · runs in the balanced power profile, launched direct

Other machines: [Desktop](/d/pzopt-machine-desktop) · [Dell (laptop)](/d/pzopt-machine-dell) · [MacBook Pro](/d/pzopt-machine-mac) · [every run](/d/pzopt-runs)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS runs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE valid) AS valid, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT enabled) AS stock,
  count(DISTINCT label) AS labels FROM runs WHERE machine = 'flip' AND $__timeFilter(started)

panels.title: Last run
panels.description: The newest run of this machine in the database, any time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM max(started)) * 1000 AS "last run" FROM runs WHERE machine = 'flip'

panels.title: What the newest runs reported
panels.description: Each distinct setup the console reported (desktop resolution, GPU, OpenGL renderer, JVM, launcher). Compare runs only within one row.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (resolution, opengl, gpu, jvm, launcher) resolution, gpu, opengl, jvm, launcher, max(started) OVER
  (PARTITION BY resolution, opengl, gpu, jvm, launcher) AS "last seen"
FROM runs WHERE machine = 'flip' AND $__timeFilter(started) ORDER BY resolution, opengl, gpu, jvm, launcher

panels.title: Stock vs PZ Optimization on the flip
Stock game
panels.description: Medians over the newest 10 runs of the headline scene (named in the middle). Average fps: route mean; 1 % low: the fps of the slowest 1 % of frames; p99 / p99.9: 99 % / 99.9 % of the frames are faster than this (stutter).

targets.rawSql: SELECT st_fps AS "average fps ↑", st_low AS "1 % low fps ↑", st_p99 AS "p99 frame time ↓", st_p999 AS "p99.9 frame time ↓" FROM (SELECT * FROM hero_scenes WHERE machine = 'flip' ORDER BY scene = 'Driving 120 km/h · uncapped' DESC, least(st_runs, o_runs) DESC, newest DESC LIMIT 1) h

panels.title: Faster than stock
panels.description: Average fps with the mod / average fps of the stock game, in the scene with the most runs both ways (its name above the number). Every scene measured both ways is in the table below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time, scene AS metric, o_fps / st_fps AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM hero_scenes WHERE machine = 'flip' ORDER BY scene = 'Driving 120 km/h · uncapped' DESC, least(st_runs, o_runs) DESC, newest DESC LIMIT 1) h

panels.title: With PZ Optimization
panels.description: Medians over the newest 10 runs of the headline scene (named in the middle). Average fps: route mean; 1 % low: the fps of the slowest 1 % of frames; p99 / p99.9: 99 % / 99.9 % of the frames are faster than this (stutter).

targets.rawSql: SELECT o_fps AS "average fps ↑", o_low AS "1 % low fps ↑", o_p99 AS "p99 frame time ↓", o_p999 AS "p99.9 frame time ↓" FROM (SELECT * FROM hero_scenes WHERE machine = 'flip' ORDER BY scene = 'Driving 120 km/h · uncapped' DESC, least(st_runs, o_runs) DESC, newest DESC LIMIT 1) h

panels.title: Each day's build on the flip: fps per benchmark
panels.description: Each day's build (its last release) on one machine (history on: desktop RTX 4090 5120x2160, flip, dell, mac) at default settings, uncapped, route-mean fps, median of the day's runs: the 120 km/h drive east on KY-60 from the Rosewood bench save (clear, and in heavy fog with a thunderstorm), the spinning walk south through Rosewood in fog and storm, the Louisville horde (~2,000 zombies) and the riverside horde shooting. A bench starts on the first day whose harness could run it. Dashed: the stock game the day's build ran on (42.20.4 until 09-27: those builds were re-measured on a 42.20.4 copy of the game; 42.21 from 09-28, ~10 % slower than 42.20.4 by itself). panels.title: Every scene measured both ways (flip)
panels.description: Medians of the newest 10 valid runs per side. Utilization: GPU busy and the busiest CPU core (sysmon) over the route; a side below its cap with neither near 100 % still has hardware left over.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scene, round((o_fps / st_fps)::numeric, 2) AS "×", st_fps AS "fps stock", o_fps AS "fps ours", st_low AS "1% low stock", o_low AS "1% low ours",
  st_p99 AS "p99 stock", o_p99 AS "p99 ours", st_p999 AS "p99.9 stock", o_p999 AS "p99.9 ours",
  st_gpu AS "GPU % stock", o_gpu AS "GPU % ours", st_core AS "busiest core % stock", o_core AS "busiest core % ours",
  st_runs AS "runs stock", o_runs AS "runs ours", newest
FROM hero_scenes WHERE machine = 'flip' ORDER BY least(st_runs, o_runs) DESC, newest DESC

SELECT count(*) AS runs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE valid) AS valid, count(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'invalid' OR NOT valid) AS invalid FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started) AND machine IN (${machine:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(mode, '') IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND label ~ ${label:sqlstring}

SELECT run, fps_mean AS fps, p99_ms AS "p99 ms", p99_9_ms AS "p99.9 ms", gpu_pct AS "GPU %", busiest_core_pct AS "busiest core %" FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started) AND machine IN (${machine:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(mode, '') IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND label ~ ${label:sqlstring} ORDER BY started DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: The newest 500 runs in the time range (narrow with the label regex or the time picker). Frame times in ms over the route window (pzopt-frames.out); CPU / GPU from sysmon, game thread from pzopt-threads.out. Click a run for its dashboard, 'previous' to compare with the last run of the same label, 'video' for its recording, 'data' for its run folder: frame logs and every other file (the cold-storage bucket gs://diegov-videos-coldline; harness/cold-store.py uploads and links them).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started, run, CASE WHEN v.url IS NOT NULL THEN 'video' END AS video, v.url AS video_url,
  CASE WHEN rd.url IS NOT NULL THEN 'data' END AS data, rd.url AS data_url, fps_mean AS fps, fps_1pct_low AS "1% low", p50_ms AS p50, p99_ms AS p99, p99_9_ms AS "p99.9", max_ms AS max,
  over_33ms AS ">33ms", jitter_ms AS jitter, cpu_pct AS "CPU %", busiest_core_pct AS "busiest core %", gpu_pct AS "GPU %",
  game_thread_pct AS "game thread %", total_w AS "W", j_per_frame AS "J/frame", CASE
  WHEN gpu_pct >= 90 THEN 'GPU-bound'
  WHEN game_thread_pct >= 90 OR game_load_pct >= 90 THEN 'game thread'
  WHEN fps_mean >= 235 AND props NOT LIKE '%uncappedFps=true%' THEN 'at 240 cap'
  WHEN fps_mean IS NULL THEN NULL
  ELSE 'headroom left' END AS bound, verdict, round(verdict_confidence::numeric, 2) AS conf, valid,
  variant, machine, mode, preset, chunk_p99_ms AS "chunk p99", gc_events AS gc, zoom, resolution, label,
  lag(run) OVER (PARTITION BY label ORDER BY started) AS previous
FROM runs LEFT JOIN run_videos v USING (run) LEFT JOIN run_data rd USING (run) WHERE $__timeFilter(started) AND machine IN (${machine:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(mode, '') IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND label ~ ${label:sqlstring} ORDER BY started DESC LIMIT 500

value.title: The run's files and frame data (cold storage)

panels.title: Trends (one point per run, series = label or machine)
fps (route mean)
panels.description: One point per run over the dashboard's time range: the route-window value from analyze.py. One series per run label while at most 20 labels are in range (narrow with the label regex), else one per machine · stock / optimized.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (SELECT started, label, machine, enabled, fps_mean AS value FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started) AND machine IN (${machine:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(mode, '') IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND label ~ ${label:sqlstring} AND fps_mean IS NOT NULL)
SELECT started AS time, CASE WHEN (SELECT count(DISTINCT label) FROM t) <= 20 THEN label
  ELSE machine || CASE WHEN enabled IS FALSE THEN ' · stock' ELSE ' · optimized' END END AS metric, value FROM t ORDER BY 1

panels.title: p99 frame time
panels.description: One point per run over the dashboard's time range: the route-window value from analyze.py. One series per run label while at most 20 labels are in range (narrow with the label regex), else one per machine · stock / optimized.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (SELECT started, label, machine, enabled, p99_ms AS value FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started) AND machine IN (${machine:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(mode, '') IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND label ~ ${label:sqlstring} AND p99_ms IS NOT NULL)
SELECT started AS time, CASE WHEN (SELECT count(DISTINCT label) FROM t) <= 20 THEN label
  ELSE machine || CASE WHEN enabled IS FALSE THEN ' · stock' ELSE ' · optimized' END END AS metric, value FROM t ORDER BY 1

panels.title: p99.9 frame time
panels.description: One point per run over the dashboard's time range: the route-window value from analyze.py. One series per run label while at most 20 labels are in range (narrow with the label regex), else one per machine · stock / optimized.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (SELECT started, label, machine, enabled, p99_9_ms AS value FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started) AND machine IN (${machine:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(mode, '') IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND label ~ ${label:sqlstring} AND p99_9_ms IS NOT NULL)
SELECT started AS time, CASE WHEN (SELECT count(DISTINCT label) FROM t) <= 20 THEN label
  ELSE machine || CASE WHEN enabled IS FALSE THEN ' · stock' ELSE ' · optimized' END END AS metric, value FROM t ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Below the cap with hardware left over
panels.description: The objective: fps below the 240 cap with neither the GPU (≥ 90 %) nor the game thread (≥ 90 %) saturated is itself a finding.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started, run, fps_mean AS fps, p99_ms AS p99, gpu_pct AS "GPU %", busiest_core_pct AS "busiest core %",
  game_thread_pct AS "game thread %", headroom_finding AS "Jev headroom"
FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started) AND machine IN (${machine:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(mode, '') IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND label ~ ${label:sqlstring} AND CASE
  WHEN gpu_pct >= 90 THEN 'GPU-bound'
  WHEN game_thread_pct >= 90 OR game_load_pct >= 90 THEN 'game thread'
  WHEN fps_mean >= 235 AND props NOT LIKE '%uncappedFps=true%' THEN 'at 240 cap'
  WHEN fps_mean IS NULL THEN NULL
  ELSE 'headroom left' END = 'headroom left' ORDER BY started DESC
